titre: Metal Thunder - 1.0 Launch: the AC-130 gunship roguelite is now multiplayer, with a new co-op Zombies mode
chapo: Hi r/Games , I'm the solo developer of Metal Thunder. I shared it here a while back as a single-player gunship game. Since then it hit 1.0 and grew into a multiplayer one: up to four players each fly their own AC-130 over the same fight, find targets through thermal, night vision or live TV, and pick the right gun for each one: Gatling, 30mm, 45mm, 105mm, guided missiles, bombs and more.
